page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c8g1.2xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server instance powered by an Intel Xeon E5-2682 v4 processor. This x86_64 architecture CPU features 8 dedicated physical cores operating at 2.5 GHz, supported by a 40 MB L3 cache. The instance is equipped with 32.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. For hardware acceleration, it includes a single NVIDIA P4 GPU based on the Pascal architecture, offering 8 GB of dedicated VRAM. Local storage is not bundled with this instance, and network connectivity is rated at a baseline of 2 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate that the instance is suited for workloads that rely on GPU acceleration rather than raw CPU compute. The single-core stress-ng CPU performance is in the bottom 10%, and multi-core performance falls in the bottom 25%. Memory bandwidth for small cached blocks is average, reaching 340.09 GB/sec, but drops to a weak 37.18 GB/sec for large uncached blocks. PassMark CPU and memory scores are generally weak to average, reflecting the older Broadwell-generation CPU architecture.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.gn5i-c8g1.2xlarge offers an entry-level GPU-accelerated profile. It is designed for workloads that require hardware acceleration but do not demand high-end modern GPU architectures. Suitable workloads include legacy deep learning inference, video transcoding, and entry-level graphics rendering. It is less suitable for CPU-heavy database operations, high-throughput web serving, or memory-intensive data processing due to its lower CPU and memory bandwidth benchmarks.
